title: RL-Based Neural Architecture Search for Deepfake Voice Detection
summary: An audio classification pipeline paired with a proof-of-concept RL-based neural architecture search over network topologies.
bullets: Built an end-to-end PyTorch pipeline for spoofed-versus-genuine speech classification spanning audio preprocessing, feature extraction, model training, and evaluation; reached 2.8% Equal Error Rate after 50 epochs with baseline deep models.
Developed a proof-of-concept reinforcement-learning Neural Architecture Search framework to search network topologies for the audio classification task.
